name: God Class (type 1)
description: Is a class that single-handedly implements large blocks of functionality within a system and performs multiple, non-cohesive functionalities

name: High Coupling
description: A class whose change affects many others, making the system complex, rigid, and fragile

name: Long Parameters List
description: Might happen after several types of algorithms are merged in a single method

name: Long Method
description: The longer the method, the more difficult it is to understand, modify, or extend. It is a sign that the method is doing too much

name: Complex Method
description: Potential difficulties in understanding and maintaining the code

name: Feature Envy
description: Indicates that the method is in the wrong place and is more tightly coupled to the other class than to the one where it is currently located

name: Brain Method
description: Is a method that seeks to centralize the functionality of the owner class, performs most of its tasks that should be distributed among several methods

name: Brain Class
description: This is a complex class that implements too much system intelligence, making it difficult to understand and maintain

name: Intensive Coupling
description: Understanding the relation between the client method and the classes providing services becomes difficult

name: Dispersed Coupling
description: A change in a dispersively coupled method leads to changes in all the dependent (coupled) classes

name: Deeply Nested Conditions
description: The more nested conditions, the more difficult it is to understand and maintain the code

name: Too Many Fields
description: A class with too many fields is difficult to understand and maintain

name: Too Many Methods
description: A class with too many methods is difficult to understand and maintain

name: Data Class
description: A class does not implement enough functionality itself to justify it being a class
